name: ^options\.now$
reason: The injected deadline clock supplies the current time; the twin compares it with the deadline itself.

name: ^options\.policyApproval$
reason: The injected policy approval callback decides a tool call; the twin checks the call it is handed and reads its answer.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.auditLedger\.append$
reason: The audit ledger is a database write in the storage backend; the twin checks the entry it appends.

name: ^client\.evaluate$
reason: The OPA policy server answers the decision request; the twin checks the path and input and passes its answer or error on.

name: ^(doGenerate|doStream|model\.doGenerate)$
reason: The language model provider answers the request; the twin checks the call and passes its answer or error on.

name: ^(workersAI|compatible|createOllama)$
reason: The provider SDK builds the model object; the twin checks the model id and settings it is given.

name: OpenAICompatibleChatLanguageModel
reason: A provider SDK model object, handed through to the caller and never inspected.

name: WorkersAIChatLanguageModel
reason: A provider SDK model object, handed through to the caller and never inspected.

name: ^clearInterval$
reason: The platform clears the lease monitor's timer and returns nothing the code reads.

name: ^runAbort\.abort$
reason: The platform AbortController aborts its signal with the given reason and returns nothing the code reads.

name: ^options\.abortSignal\?\.removeEventListener$
reason: The platform AbortSignal detaches the listener and returns nothing the code reads.

name: DefaultStepResult
reason: The AI SDK's step result object, handed in by the SDK and only read for its listed fields.

name: MockLanguageModelV4
reason: The AI SDK's test language model, passed through in the step callback arguments and never inspected.
